parameters.content:
## Setup v2
1. Corre `n8n/schema.sql` en Postgres (incluye leads WhatsApp).
2. Mapea credenciales: Telegram, Postgres, DeepSeek.
3. `allowedChatIds` en Config: vacío = todos; o `123,456` para allowlist.
4. n8n debe tener HTTPS público (webhook de Telegram y de Evolution).
5. Activa este workflow y prueba texto. Cron avisos = 02. WhatsApp leads = 03+04.

Las tools del agente son **Postgres Tool** (`postgresTool` v2.6), no el nodo Postgres del flujo.
Modelo: `deepseek-v4-flash`.
Si falla con `reasoning_content` al usar tools, apaga thinking o usa OpenAI Chat Model con base URL `https://api.deepseek.com` y la misma key.

## Memoria
- Tabla `assistant_chat_messages`: últimas **10 interacciones** (nodo Postgres Chat Memory).
- Tabla `conversation_summaries`: compactado de lo que ya salió de la ventana.
- Si hay más de 20 filas de mensajes, se resume con DeepSeek y se borran las viejas.
El resumen entra al system prompt para no perder clientes/fechas antiguas.

parameters.toolDescription: Crea dos avisos a las 10:00 hora Venezuela: t3 (3 dias antes) y day (el dia). estimated_date DEBE ser YYYY-MM-DD. Si el usuario dio un rango, usa la PRIMERA fecha. Si solo dio dia/mes, el año es el vigente en Venezuela (ya viene en el system prompt). Pedir confirmacion antes de llamar. Parametros: client_name, client_phone, estimated_date.
parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS telegram_chat_id,
    btrim($2::text) AS client_name,
    regexp_replace($3::text, '[^0-9+]', '', 'g') AS client_phone,
    $4::date AS estimated_date
),
planned AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    k.kind,
    (
      (CASE WHEN k.kind = 't3' THEN i.estimated_date - 3 ELSE i.estimated_date END)
      + TIME '10:00'
    ) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS fire_at
  FROM input i
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('t3'), ('day')) AS k(kind)
)
INSERT INTO followup_reminders (
  telegram_chat_id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date, kind, fire_at, status
)
SELECT
  telegram_chat_id,
  client_name,
  client_phone,
  estimated_date,
  kind,
  fire_at,
  CASE WHEN fire_at <= now() THEN 'skipped' ELSE 'pending' END
FROM planned
WHERE client_name <> '' AND client_phone <> ''
ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id, client_phone, estimated_date, kind)
DO UPDATE SET
  client_name = EXCLUDED.client_name,
  fire_at = EXCLUDED.fire_at,
  status = CASE
    WHEN followup_reminders.status = 'sent' THEN followup_reminders.status
    ELSE EXCLUDED.status
  END
RETURNING id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date, kind, fire_at, status;

parameters.toolDescription: Lista los seguimientos pending o skipped del usuario de este chat de Telegram.
parameters.query:
SELECT id, client_name, client_phone, estimated_date::text AS estimated_date, kind,
       to_char(fire_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS fire_local,
       status
FROM followup_reminders
WHERE telegram_chat_id = $1
  AND status IN ('pending', 'skipped')
ORDER BY estimated_date, kind;

parameters.toolDescription: Cancela seguimientos pending del chat actual buscando por nombre (min 3 letras) o telefono del cliente.
parameters.query:
UPDATE followup_reminders
SET status = 'cancelled'
WHERE telegram_chat_id = $1
  AND status = 'pending'
  AND (
    (
      regexp_replace($2::text, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') <> ''
      AND regexp_replace(client_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || regexp_replace($2::text, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') || '%'
    )
    OR (
      char_length(btrim($2::text)) >= 3
      AND lower(client_name) LIKE '%' || lower(btrim($2::text)) || '%'
    )
  )
RETURNING id, client_name, client_phone, kind, estimated_date, status;

parameters.toolDescription: Lista clientes de WhatsApp para difusion o potenciales, con scores 0-100 (potencial, engagement, cierre, silencio), nombre, telefono y etapa. Incluye pregunto_no_concreto, no_respondio y en_proceso callados >12h tras cotizacion. No inventes filas. El asistente DEBE mostrar los scores al usuario.
parameters.query:
SELECT display_name, phone, stage,
       score_potencial, score_engagement, score_cierre, score_silencio,
       sentiment_last,
       to_char(last_client_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_client_local,
       last_reason
FROM leads
WHERE stage IN ('pregunto_no_concreto', 'no_respondio')
   OR (
     stage = 'en_proceso'
     AND quoted_at IS NOT NULL
     AND score_cierre < 50
     AND score_potencial >= 40
     AND last_client_at <= now() - interval '12 hours'
   )
ORDER BY score_potencial DESC, last_client_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30;

parameters.toolDescription: Lista clientes de WhatsApp que preguntan mucho y no reservan (engagement alto, cierre bajo, no concreto). Para 'los que preguntan y nunca cierran'.
parameters.query:
SELECT display_name, phone, stage, score_engagement, score_cierre,
       client_msg_count,
       to_char(last_client_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_client_local,
       last_reason
FROM leads
WHERE stage <> 'concreto'
  AND score_engagement >= 50
  AND score_cierre < 50
ORDER BY score_engagement DESC, client_msg_count DESC
LIMIT 30;

parameters.toolDescription: Estadistica del embudo WhatsApp en un mes: conversaciones, reservaron, preguntaron sin cerrar, no respondieron, en proceso y pct_reservaciones. periodo en YYYY-MM; si el usuario no dice mes, pasa el mes actual de Venezuela.
parameters.query:
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($1::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d) AS start_at,
         date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month' AS end_at
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
)
SELECT
  to_char(b.start_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS periodo,
  COUNT(l.id)::int AS conversaciones,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'concreto')::int AS reservaron,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'pregunto_no_concreto')::int AS preguntaron_sin_cerrar,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'no_respondio')::int AS no_respondieron,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'en_proceso')::int AS en_proceso,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.stage = 'concreto') / NULLIF(COUNT(l.id), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_reservaciones
FROM bounds b
LEFT JOIN first_touch f
  ON f.first_at >= b.start_at AND f.first_at < b.end_at
LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id
GROUP BY b.start_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$fromAI('periodo', 'Mes a consultar en YYYY-MM. Si el usuario no indica mes, usa el mes actual de Venezuela', 'string')] }}

parameters.toolDescription: Lista por nombre y telefono los leads de WhatsApp de un mes. tipo OBLIGATORIO: concretaron (reservaron, stage concreto), no_concretaron (todos los que no reservaron), atendidos (todos los del mes). periodo YYYY-MM; si el usuario no dice mes, usa el mes actual de Venezuela. No inventes filas.
parameters.query:
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $2::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($2::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d) AS start_at,
         date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month' AS end_at
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(b.start_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS periodo,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.display_name), ''), '(sin nombre)') AS display_name,
    l.phone,
    l.stage,
    l.score_potencial,
    l.score_engagement,
    l.score_cierre,
    to_char(l.last_client_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_client_local,
    l.last_reason
  FROM first_touch f
  JOIN leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE f.first_at >= b.start_at AND f.first_at < b.end_at
)
SELECT *
FROM base
WHERE CASE
  WHEN lower(btrim($1::text)) IN ('concretaron', 'concreto', 'reservaron', 'reservas') THEN stage = 'concreto'
  WHEN lower(btrim($1::text)) IN ('no_concretaron', 'no concreto', 'no_concreto', 'no reservaron') THEN stage <> 'concreto'
  ELSE true
END
ORDER BY CASE stage
  WHEN 'concreto' THEN 1
  WHEN 'en_proceso' THEN 2
  WHEN 'pregunto_no_concreto' THEN 3
  ELSE 4
END,
last_client_local DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 50;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$fromAI('tipo', 'concretaron, no_concretaron o atendidos', 'string'), $fromAI('periodo', 'Mes YYYY-MM. Si el usuario no indica mes, usa el mes actual de Venezuela', 'string')] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT id, message
FROM assistant_chat_messages
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND id NOT IN (
    SELECT id FROM assistant_chat_messages
    WHERE session_id = $1
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 20
  )
ORDER BY id ASC;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversation_summaries (telegram_chat_id, summary, last_compacted_at, messages_compacted, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, now(), $3, now())
ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  last_compacted_at = now(),
  messages_compacted = conversation_summaries.messages_compacted + EXCLUDED.messages_compacted,
  updated_at = now();

DELETE FROM assistant_chat_messages
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND id NOT IN (
    SELECT id FROM assistant_chat_messages
    WHERE session_id = $1
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 20
  );
